dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Amir, I have a problem. I think I accidentally submitted the wrong file for my English essay. I submitted an old draft instead of the final version. What should I do?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Oh no! You should email your lecturer immediately. Don't wait — the sooner you contact them, the better. Explain what happened honestly.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: But should I be worried? Will they be angry? I've heard some lecturers are very strict about submission rules.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: You shouldn't panic. Mistakes happen. You should explain it was an accident and attach the correct file straight away. Most lecturers appreciate honesty much more than excuses.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Should I go to see them in person, or is an email enough?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: An email is fine for the first contact. But if they don't reply by tomorrow, you should go to their office hours. You mustn't leave it too long without a response.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: OK. And should I also tell my academic advisor?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: You don't have to tell the advisor at this stage — it's a small mistake, not an academic violation. But if the lecturer doesn't respond positively, then you should involve the advisor.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: That makes sense. Actually, now I'm also worried about my end-of-semester presentation. I haven't prepared anything yet! Should I be stressed?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: You shouldn't stress, but you really should start today. You mustn't leave it to the last minute. How much time do you have?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Definitely! Two weeks is plenty of time if you use it well. You should plan your structure first, then research, then practise. You shouldn't try to do everything in one day — break it into small tasks.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: You're so calm about everything. How do you stay organised? Do you have any other advice?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Well, you should use a planner — digital or paper, whatever works for you. And you mustn't forget to sleep properly. Tired people make more mistakes. And finally — you should celebrate small victories. You're doing great, Zhibek!
